title: Cambridge IELTS 16 Test 4 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The diagram below shows the process for recycling plastic bottles.
scenario: The diagram below shows the process for recycling plastic bottles.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: How plastic bottles are recycled
labels: 7 Heating pellets to form raw material
notes: The process begins with plastic bottles being placed in a recycling bin.
A collection truck transports the bottles to a recycling centre.
At the recycling centre, the bottles are sorted into accepted and rejected materials.
Accepted bottles are compressed into blocks, crushed into small pieces and washed.
The washed pieces are made into plastic pellets, which are heated to form raw material.
The raw material is used to produce end products shown as bottles, food containers, a T-shirt, a shopping bag and pencils.
